applyLegacyLedgerConfirmation loads and mutates payment.reference by attacker-chosen :id with no canAccessUnit scope check (mark-paid/settle both check it), so a manager can write to any portfolio's payment record outside their assigned buildings.

applyLedgerConfirmation has the same missing scope binding: any manager can post a (validly encrypted) ledger confirmation to any payment id, overwriting reference on a payment outside their buildings.
